verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              ततो ममितविश्वस्तं संरूढशरविक्षतम्। देवराजो विगृह्येदं काले वचनमब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: Arjuna said : Then the lord of the gods, seeing me, highly faithful and wounded with a arrows and acknowledging me as his own, duly spoke these words. me

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि सर्वाणि त्वयि तिष्ठन्ति भारत। न त्वाऽभिभवितुं शक्तो मानुषो भुवि कश्चन॥२॥
verses.english: "O Bharata, all the celestials weapons are with you; (therefore) no mortal on earth shall by any means be capable of conquering you.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत इति । अतिविश्वस्तमति - अत्यन्तं विश्वस्तं शत्रून् जेष्यतीति विश्वासो यस्मिंस्तम् । संरूढाः देहे निमग्नाः शरास्तैर्विक्षतम् । विगृह्य विशेषेण गृहीत्वा स्वीयत्वेन अङ्गीकृत्येर्थः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णः शकुनिः सह राजभिः। सङ्ग्रामस्थस्य ते पुत्र कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्॥३॥
verses.english: O son, when you will be engaged in battle, Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karma, Shakuni, together with (other) kings, shall not approach (in strength) a sixteenth part of yours."

verses.sanskrit: इदं च मे तनुत्राणं प्रायच्छन्मघवान् प्रभुः। अभेद्यं कवचं दिव्यं स्रजं चैव हिरण्मयीम्॥४॥
verses.english: The lord Maghavan gave this impenetrable celestials armour capable of protecting the body, this golden garland,

verses.sanskrit: देवदत्तं च मे शङ्खं पुनः प्रादान्महारवम्। दिव्यं चेदं किरीटं मे स्वयमिन्द्रो युयोज ह॥५॥
verses.english: And also this conch, Devadatta, emitting forth loud roars. (And) Indra himself fixed this coronet (on my head).

verses.sanskrit: ततो दिव्यानि वस्त्राणि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च। प्रादाच्छक्रो ममैतानि रुचिराणि बृहन्ति च॥६॥
verses.english: Shakra then granted me these precious and beautiful celestials garments and these hcavenly ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूजितस्तत्र सुखमस्म्युषितो नृप। इन्द्रस्य भवने पुण्ये गन्धवंशिशुभिः सह॥७॥
verses.english: Thus, O king, duly honoured, I dwelt cheerfully in the abode of Indra with the children of the Gandharvas.
verses.bhavadeepa: रुचिराणि दीप्तिमन्ति । अत एव बृहन्ति बहुमूल्यानि ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: ततो मामब्रवीच्छक्रः प्रीतिमानमरैः सह। समयोऽर्जुन गन्तुं ते भ्रातरो हि स्मरन्ति ते॥८॥
verses.english: Then Shakra, well pleased, unanimously with the immortals spoke to me: “O Arjuna, the time for your departure has (now) arrived, your brothers are thinking of you.”

verses.sanskrit: एवमिन्द्रस्य भत्रने पञ्च वर्षाणि भारत। उषितानि मया राजन् स्मरता द्यूतजं कलिम्॥९॥
verses.english: Thus, O monarch, remembering the troubles brought on (us) by gambling I passed (these) five years in the abode of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भवन्तमद्राक्षं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितम्। गन्धमादनपादस्य पर्वतस्यास्य मूर्धनि॥१०॥
verses.english: Then did I behold you surrounded by (my other) brothers on the summit of the lower range of the mountain Gandhamadana.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              दिष्ट्या धनञ्जयास्त्राणि त्वया प्राप्तानि भारत। दिष्ट्या चाराधितो राजा देवानामीश्वरः प्रभुः॥११॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said: O Dhananjaya, fortunately you have obtained these celestials weapons and it is by good luck too, that you have worshipped the lord king of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या च भगवान् स्थाणुर्देव्या सह परन्तप। साक्षाद्दृष्टः स्वयुद्धेन तोषितश्च त्वयाऽनघ॥१२॥
verses.english: And luckily, O tormentor of foes, O sinless being, you have beheld that very god, Sthanu himself, together with the goddess and pleased them by fighting

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या च लोकपालैस्त्वं समेतो भरतर्षभ। दिष्ट्या वर्धामहे पार्थ दिष्ट्याऽसि पुनरागतः॥१३॥
verses.english: And O the best of the Bharatas, luckily it is that you have obtained an interview with the Lokapalas. It is because you are fortunate that we have prospered and fortunately you have come back.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य कृत्स्नां महीं देवीं विजितां पुरमालिनीम्। मन्ये च धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रानपि वशीकृतान्॥१४॥
verses.english: Today do I consider the entire earth, adorned with cities, as conquered and the sons of Dhritarashtra as subdued.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छामि तानि चास्त्राणि द्रष्टुं दिव्यानि भारत। यैस्तथा वीर्यवन्तस्ते निवातकवचा हताः॥१५॥
verses.english: O Bharata, (now) I wish to see those celestials weapons by means of which you destroyed the powerful Nivatakavachas.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              श्वः प्रभाते भवान् द्रष्टा दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः। निवातकवचा घोरा यैर्मया विनिपातिताः॥१६॥
verses.english: Arjuna said : You will behold tomorrow morning all those celestials weapons whereby the Nivatakavachas were slain.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमागमनं तत्र कथयित्वा धनञ्जयः। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वै रजनीं तामुवास ह॥१७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having thus related the events in connection with his arrival there, Dhananjaya passed that night there together with all his brothers.
